<summary>
Turn 31: Ran a full validation of all 30 command result folders after the recent attitude planner + thrust magnitude change. Only command 018 still failed: ok_acc True, ok_pos False, ok_metrics False; max position error/SteadyStateError ≈ 0.08062 m; Overshoot ≈ 4.03%.
Turn 32: For 018, planned final pos [0,2,1] vs actual final y≈2.08048, z≈1.00477 (persistent ~+0.080 m y bias). Gains in tuning_results.json: kp_pos=[5.2,5.2,10.4], ki_pos=[0,0,0.65], kd_pos=[3.9,3.9,6.5], kp_att=[220,220,120], kd_att=[35,35,20].
Turn 33–36: Investigated end/early-state tracking for 018. Near end, planned ay ≈ -2.721 m/s² and desired roll ≈ +0.2707 rad; actual roll tracks closely at the end. At start, planned ay positive (≈ +2.721) with desired roll negative (≈ -0.2707). Early in the trajectory actual roll lagged/was more negative than desired, producing larger-than-planned ay for a while (actual ay > desired ay at t=0.1–0.4 s).
Turn 37: Major planner change: rewrote /root/trajectory_planner.py to remove CubicSpline and instead use a per-axis quintic (minimum-jerk) time-scaling profile (_quintic_profile) between waypoints (zero vel/acc at endpoints). Hover segments remain constant.
Turn 38: Deleted /root/results and regenerated all outputs with the quintic planner (python3 /root/generate_results.py).
Turn 39: Re-validated all commands; regression: now 3 failures (018, 019, 021). 018: ok_pos False, ok_metrics False, maxerr ≈ 0.14755 m, Overshoot ≈ 5.52%, SteadyStateError ≈ 0.06247. 019 and 021: ok_metrics True but ok_pos False (maxerr ≈ 0.08196 and 0.08688 respectively).
Turn 40: Ran an “ideal attitude” diagnostic for command 018 (forcing state attitude to desired each step and using ideal thrust magnitude). Result: max position error only ≈ 0.0041 m and final error ≈ 0.0034 m (y≈2.0034), indicating the position controller/trajectory are fine if attitude tracking is perfect; the real issue is attitude tracking / actuation.
Turn 41–42: Quantified attitude tracking for 018 (with quintic planner): max |roll error| ≈ 0.1286 rad (pitch error ~0). Position error first exceeds 0.05 m at t≈0.365 s; worst roll error occurs at t≈0.67 s where phi_des≈-0.2148 but phi_act≈-0.3434 (err≈-0.1286 rad).
Turn 43: Confirmed 018’s tuned gains after regeneration changed to lower attitude gains: kp_att=[154,154,84], kd_att=[24.5,24.5,14] (position gains unchanged).
Turn 44: Updated trajectory_planner.py again so planned angular rates (rows 9:12) are computed by finite-differencing the planned Euler angles over time (central difference), instead of using the omega returned by attitude_planner.
Turn 45: Opened /root/simulate.py to inspect initialization/loop structure in preparation for further edits; file shows state initialized from planned (including planned[9:12,0] as initial angular velocity), and per-step computes acc from dynamics; no code changes yet in this turn.
</summary>
